text: Evidence from ScalaFIM (commit 7d0ac861cdd24e1717521d9b18faaef1d7df3b80): for the TemplateFlow 2009c<-6Asym composite, SimpleITK fixed-point iteration y <- y + (x - T(y)) from y = x (no lattice warm start) converges to <= 1e-10 mm at all 64,984 fsLR vertices, in at most 33 iterations, all inside the displacement support. That is promising for the identity initialization required by scope item 2, but it is ITK behaviour on one map, not provider qualification. Consumer-side value checks show that sub-0.1 mm placement errors flip nearest voxels with value changes of up to 4 SD, so the consumer will judge the provider result by agreement with the converged oracle, not just residual magnitude.
